# ShopIndia — Privacy Policy

Last updated: August 2026

## 1. Information We Collect

We collect the following personal information:
- Full name
- Email address
- Phone number
- Delivery address
- Order history and purchase details

## 2. How We Use Your Information

We use your personal information to:
- Process and fulfil your orders
- Send order confirmation and delivery updates via SMS
- Manage your account and purchases
- Respond to customer service requests

## 3. SMS Communications

We use Twilio to send order confirmation SMS messages
to your registered phone number. Your phone number is
shared with Twilio solely for this purpose.

## 4. Data Sharing

We share your information only with:
- Twilio — for SMS order confirmations (phone number only)
- Delivery partners — for order fulfilment (name and address only)

We do not share your data with advertising or analytics companies.

## 5. Data Retention

We retain your personal data for as long as your account
is active or as required by law.

## 6. Contact

privacy@shopindia.in
